scope: Retain18bilingualspoken cues across both films; measured directors, causal state and bounded model corrections, same chapter IDs/windows; concise English captions only.

cues.title: 接通的瞬间
cues.caption: 原线圈电流变化，副线圈才响应。
cues.captionEn: Changing primary current induces an emf.
cues.zh: 沿着铁环认出两组导线：它们彼此绝缘。合上开关，原线圈的电流开始建立，穿过副线圈的磁通也随之改变。留意电流计的偏转，以及两条波形不同的形状。
cues.en: Follow the two insulated windings around the iron ring. Closing the switch builds the primary current and changes the flux linking the secondary. Notice the meter response and the different shapes of the two traces.

cues.title: 电流稳定以后
cues.caption: 有磁场，不等于持续产生电动势。
cues.captionEn: Steady flux gives zero induced emf.
cues.zh: 电源仍然接通，原线圈仍有电流，铁环里的磁通也没有消失。但副线圈的电动势已经归零。互感响应的是磁通的变化，而不是磁通本身有多大。
cues.en: The source remains connected. Primary current and magnetic flux remain present, yet the secondary emf is zero. Mutual induction responds to changing flux, not simply to the amount of flux present.

cues.title: 断开后反向
cues.caption: 磁通减小，感应电动势方向反转。
cues.zh: 现在断开电源。原线圈电流衰减，磁通随之减小。电流计向另一侧偏转。比较接通和断开：原电流并没有反向，改变的是它增加还是减少。
cues.en: Open the switch. Primary current decays and the linked flux decreases. The meter deflects the other way. The primary current has not reversed; its rate of change has.

cues.title: 连续传送音频信号
cues.caption: 变化的原电流，不需要电接触就能传递信号。
cues.zh: 换成套在一起的两个线圈。内线圈接音频信号源，外线圈接接收装置。画面慢放几个周期：每当原电流变化最快，副线圈电动势最大；在原电流达到峰值的瞬间，电动势反而经过零。
cues.en: Now nest one coil inside another. The inner winding receives an audio-frequency signal and the outer winding feeds a receiver. In slow motion, the secondary emf peaks when primary current changes fastest. At the current peak, emf crosses zero.

cues.title: 抽出以后比较
cues.caption: 相同信号源，更小的耦合带来更弱的接收信号。
cues.captionEn: Weaker coupling gives a weaker signal.
cues.zh: 把内线圈抽出一些，并在新的位置停稳。保持原信号的频率和幅度，观察副线圈电动势减小。不是电子跨过了间隙，而是两线圈共享的变化磁通减少了。
cues.en: Withdraw the inner coil and let it stop at the new position. Keep the source frequency and amplitude unchanged. The secondary emf is smaller because less changing flux links both coils; electrons do not jump across the gap.

question.zh: 两组导线没接通，指针为什么会偏转？
question.en: Why does the meter move without a wire connection?

lead.zh: 比较接通、保持直流和断开的同一套铁环线圈。
lead.en: Compare closing, steady direct current and opening in the same iron-ring apparatus.

principle.zh: 副线圈响应磁通的变化；原电流方向不变，增减方向相反也会让感应电动势反向。
principle.en: The secondary responds to changing flux. Reversing whether primary current rises or falls reverses emf without reversing the current itself.

question.zh: 维持更强但不变的电流，副线圈会一直响应吗？
question.en: Would a stronger but steady primary current keep producing a response?

explanation.zh: 不会。在这里的固定几何模型中，稳定磁通的变化率为零，不持续产生感应电动势。
explanation.en: No. At fixed geometry, steady flux has zero time derivative and does not sustain an induced emf.

question.zh: 没有电接触，线圈怎样传递信号？
question.en: How can coils transfer a signal without contact?

lead.zh: 保留相同的电流信号，比较线圈停在不同套入位置后的接收响应。
lead.en: Keep the same drive current and compare received responses at different stationary insertions.

principle.zh: 变化的电流产生变化的磁通；线圈耦合越弱，同样变化率产生的接收电动势越小。
principle.en: Changing current changes linked flux. Weaker coupling gives a smaller induced emf for the same current rate of change.

question.zh: 保持套入程度与电流幅度，提高频率，会怎样？
question.en: What changes if frequency rises at fixed insertion and current amplitude?

explanation.zh: 在本线性高阻模型中，电流变化率增大，感应电动势幅值增大；这不能直接换算真实扬声器响度。
explanation.en: In this linear high-impedance model, the current changes faster and the induced emf amplitude rises. This does not directly determine loudspeaker volume.
